title: Forensic workflow map
note: Map of the modules that already exist for each stage. Nothing here is merged or rewritten. Paths are relative to the repository root. 'checked' lists only commands run offline when this map was written (2026-11-20); everything else is described from the code, not from a run.

entry_points: cd monitoring && python3 -m phi_monitor run --db X
cd monitoring && python3 -m phi_engine run --db X
stages.input: Polygon eth_getLogs (OrderFilled, ERC-20 Transfer), Polymarket data API, Gamma and CLOB websocket
stages.output: three separate stores: phi_monitor SQLite (fills, prices, baselines, funding, alerts), phi_engine SQLite (fills of 1,000 USD or more and watched wallets, entries, deposits, links, alerts), livecollect files
checked: cd monitoring && python3 -B -W error -m unittest discover -s tests: 93 tests OK (fake network and committed fixtures only)
stages.gap: No single collector: three collectors pull overlapping fills, tape and prices into three stores that are not interchangeable. Live collection was not run here. livecollect has no test under monitoring/tests except the decoder conformance test.

stages.input: raw OrderFilled logs; monitoring funding rows; alert bodies
stages.output: fill dicts (floats in chain and feed, raw integer strings in livecollect); evidence edges; flat alert records
checked: test_decoder_conformance: the three decoders agree on log index, exchange, maker or wallet, taker or counterparty, token id, side and amounts for the 14 logs of monitoring/fixtures/orderfilled_20261113.json
cd integrations/forensic-intelligence && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests: 55 tests OK
stages.gap: Three OrderFilled v2 decoders plus a v1 one remain, with different units, fee handling, removed-log handling and fields (livecollect fills hold no transaction hash). Three tape row shapes: phi_monitor store.tape drops tx and outcome_index, which the position ledger needs. No shared schema document for fills or tape.

stages.input: tape rows (rowid, cid, ts, wallet, side, outcome, outcome_index, size, price, tx) from its own tape SQLite; activity rows for asof
stages.output: position events, payoff vectors and classes; wallet history as of a time
stages.gap: Not run here: test_ledger.py is pytest-style, pytest is not a dependency and unittest discovery finds 0 tests. Nothing feeds the position ledger from the monitoring stores. Five different modules are named ledger.py with five meanings.

entry_points: cd monitoring && python3 -m phi_monitor run --db X (fills the funding table)
stages.input: phi_monitor funding rows (tx, log_index, block, ts, proxy, payer, token, amount, payer_kind, payer_nonce); phi_engine deposits and links
stages.output: clusters of wallets sharing a plain-key payer; evidence edges, financial graph, CSV, JSON and GraphML exports
checked: test_monitor_bridge: the 2 funding rows of monitoring/fixtures/nobel_machado_20251009.json become 2 valid edges and 2 financial-graph edges; rows with a missing field are refused
stages.gap: funding_to_edges reads phi_monitor funding rows only. phi_engine deposits rows carry no log index and no token and are refused, so phi_engine funding cannot reach the evidence ledger without new data. No command runs the bridge on a live store. Label and role tables (account_kind, chainfund.INFRA, pair_links node_roles) are separate.

entry_points: cd monitoring && python3 -m phi_monitor replay --db X
cd monitoring && python3 -m phi_engine replay --db X
stages.output: phi_monitor alert bodies (level LONELY_THIN, LONELY, THIN; market-centric) and phi_engine alert bodies (class C1 to C7, R1, M1; wallet-centric); normalise_alert maps both to one flat record
checked: test_replay (in the 93 monitoring tests): the stored Machado evening raises 1 LONELY_THIN alert
test_monitor_bridge: normalise_alert maps that alert and the C1_FRESH_FUNDED_BET alert of test_engine
stages.gap: Two detectors with two alert schemas and two journals. normalise_alert gives one record shape, but nothing downstream reads it yet: no validation, registry or report consumes monitoring alerts.

stages.input: scored rows of each tool or frozen study tables
stages.output: p-values, confidence intervals, verdicts per study
checked: cd integrations/quantitative_engine && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests: 35 tests OK
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s edge_research/tests: 6 tests OK
stages.gap: No reusable function takes an alert set and returns a validated verdict; study statistics are per study and frozen. The multiple-testing count is per tool, not global. The study verify scripts were not run here.

stages.input: evidence edges; investigation folders (README, STATUS, FINDINGS, EVIDENCE, data manifests)
stages.output: validated edges and exports; evidence check report
stages.gap: Evidence for published findings is produced by hand-written per-note scripts. Only the forensic-intelligence edge schema is reusable, and no monitoring code writes it: funding_to_edges is a library function, not a step any collector calls.

stages.input: phi_engine alert bodies; investigation STATUS and FINDINGS Markdown
stages.output: plain-text alert reports; master report; registry of findings and wallet mentions
checked: cd integrations/phi_registry && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests: 34 tests OK
python3 -B scripts/build_master_report.py --check: reports up to date
stages.gap: The registry parses Markdown only: alert ids, journal hashes and edge exports are not ingested, so an alert never becomes a finding or an open item. Alert reports and finding reports share no template or ids.
